shots.focal_element: The purple 'User feedback' slide frame with Ashley's named yellow cursor, flanked by an image frame and a speech-bubble feedback cluster
on_screen_text: People are struggling in two main areas:
1. Battery life is reported as inconsistent
2. App syncing breaks unexpectedly during onboarding
shots.typography: Product UI text inside the recorded board: rounded geometric sans, bold sentence-case headline over regular-weight body with bold keyword emphasis; tiny medium-weight sans in the presentation toolbar and cursor name tag. Font guess (low confidence): a Miro-style geometric sans.
shots.what_happens: Presentation mode at frame 1/10: the board view slowly pans left across the row of frames so the 'User feedback' slide drifts from centre-right toward centre while Ashley's cursor moves over the feedback bubbles (VO w35-w37 'She can also').
shots.build_rebuild: Render a wide strip of slide frames on a light canvas and translate it horizontally ~25% of viewport width over 1.3 s with an ease-in-out, keeping a fixed bottom-centre presentation toolbar and a labelled cursor sprite moving independently.

shots.focal_element: A sequence of board frames ('The data', 'Risks', 'Alignment and next steps', 'Timeline', 'thanks', 'Questions, answers, and feedback') sliding past under Ashley's cursor
on_screen_text: Alignment with Support and Marketing on customer response plan
shots.typography: In-board slide titles in rounded geometric sans: bold sentence case in blue on white frames, bold white on coloured frames ('Risks', 'Timeline', large lowercase 'thanks'); numbered steps in large white numerals inside blue circles; small all-caps month labels. Sticky-note texts are too small and blurred to read.
shots.what_happens: Illustrating 'navigate the board by simply panning around' (w38-w44), the camera pans fast leftward through roughly six frames in 3.5 s, with motion blur between frames, and settles on the 'Questions, answers, and feedback' frame with stickers and sticky notes.
shots.build_rebuild: Lay out six slide frames side by side on a canvas and animate a horizontal camera pan through them in steps (hold ~0.4 s per frame, move with ease-in-out plus a light horizontal motion blur), ending zoomed slightly into the last frame.

shots.focal_element: An isolated, perspective-tilted presentation toolbar with its frame list (1. Intro, 2. Goals, 3. Data, 4. Feedback, 5. Data) and Ashley's cursor
shots.typography: Small UI sans, regular weight, sentence case with numbered list items and right-aligned duration labels; cursor tag in medium-weight sans on a yellow pill. Rendered italic-looking only because of the skewed plane.
shots.what_happens: On an empty light-grey background the toolbar and its frame list fade in as a small skewed floating card, drift and grow slightly while Ashley's cursor selects '2. Goals' (row highlights blue), then the card slides right/down and fades as VO says 'using the presentations toolbar to move from frame to frame' (w48-w57).
shots.build_rebuild: Isolate the toolbar and frame-list as a card on a plain background, apply a skewX/rotateX tilt with a soft drop shadow, fade and scale it in from ~70% to 100%, animate a cursor to row 2 and switch its background to the accent blue, then translate the card out with a fade.

shots.focal_element: The presentation toolbar's facilitation popover (Breakout frames, Timer, Voting, Limited Tools toggle and tool icons) with Ashley's cursor
on_screen_text: Align on the problem statement and next steps
The launch was a cross-functional effort. Today we are focused on product feedback, not marketing activities
shots.typography: Slide text in bold white rounded geometric sans (sentence-case two-line headings, bold bullets); popover in small regular-weight UI sans, sentence case, with a blue toggle; cursor tags in medium sans on yellow (Ashley) and blue (Sophia) pills.
shots.what_happens: The board moves from the 'User feedback' frame to the green/slate 'Goals for today' slide (frame 2/10), then the camera pushes in hard toward the bottom toolbar; a popover opens and Ashley's cursor hovers Breakout frames, Timer and Voting and clicks Limited Tools icons, matching VO 'start a timer, voting session, or breakout... pick which tools everyone can use' (w62-w79). Sophia's blue cursor sits idle at left.
shots.build_rebuild: Start on a full-slide view, then scale the canvas ~2.5x toward the bottom-centre toolbar over ~1 s with ease-out, spawn a popover above the toolbar with a short fade/translate-up, and script the cursor to hover each menu row in sync with the VO word timings before tapping the tool icons.

shots.focal_element: The full 'Goals for today' / 'Non-goals for today' split slide with traffic-light stickers
on_screen_text: Align on the problem statement and next steps
The launch was a cross-functional effort. Today we are focused on product feedback, not marketing activities
shots.typography: Bold white rounded geometric sans: two-line sentence-case headings, medium-bold bullets; popover and toolbar in small regular UI sans.
shots.what_happens: The camera zooms back out to show the whole split slide (green goals half, slate non-goals half, traffic-light stickers); the facilitation popover closes around 36.5 s and the toolbar returns to rest, then the view eases slightly further out into a held wide shot. VO ends 'so they don't get too distracted' (w82-w85) at the start, then music only.
shots.build_rebuild: Reverse the previous push-in by scaling the canvas from the toolbar close-up back to fit-to-slide over ~0.5 s with ease-out, fade the popover out on a beat, then apply a gentle 3-5% scale-down drift to hold the wide view.
